notes.title: Kip and Odosan: Major Update 1 Released
notes.content:
The first major update to Kip and Odosan is live! We are also offering a 65% launch discount for the week!

It includes significant updates based on gamer feedback to the opening levels to improve difficulty curve and fairness, so we hope everyone finds the opening levels more engaging and fun!

Check out the teaser video here and download and play today while its on sale!

[previewyoutube=rHUA3mOOoJ4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Kip and Odosan Major Update 1 to Release July 18, 2024
notes.content:
Our first major update for Kip and Odosan will release July 18, 2024. 

It includes steam achievements, an updated open to the first level featuring Odosan, and lots of level improvements based on player feedback.

[previewyoutube=rHUA3mOOoJ4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: First Major Update Coming Soon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217114/511a4ef8c8ec4dd75fcb664d694f58e38d1c171e.png[/img]

We are excited to answer we are in the final stages of completing our first major update to Kip and Odosan. The big changes include:

1. Steam achievements - 8 achievements including 100% the game along with other key game play rewards.
2. New level content in the opening level including playing as both Odosan and Kip.
3. New opening level updates to smooth out a few overly difficult stretches early in the game.
4. A new enemy and some big changes to level 1 to enhance it further.
5. Some further game play polish to level 2 and 3 based on player feedback.

We'll update again soon with the final date and details!

notes.title: Update Notes for Dec 18, 2023 - Build 1.0.6 - Fix Crash
notes.content: For those playing on certain language settings there was an issue where the game would crash on starting the first level. This has been fixed and should work across language/locale settings on windows without issue.

notes.title: Build 1.0.4 - December 9 Update
notes.content:
One more attempt to close the intermittent crash for some when video ends at start of Level 1.
Hopefully this does it! If anyone is having issues with the opening Video, you can press '9' on the keyboard on the level select screen at anytime and for that game session the video will be skipped always for level 1.

notes.title: Build 1.0.2 Update
notes.content: Really small update. Pressing '8' will switch the game into Windowed mode. Also you can add the word windowed to launch options in steam (under General in Properties menu in Steam for Kip And Odosan) and it will permanently launch windowed.

notes.title: Update Notes For Dec. 9, 2023 (Build 1.0.1)
notes.content: Fix for the opening video stutters, and if video playback is causing an issue on your machine, pressing '9' on the keyboard will suppress playing the video.
